description.en: Checks a bid requirement by requirement against a tender requirements pack and reports which requirements appear answered, weakly matched or not located; it reports differences rather than judging substantive compliance.
description.zh: 按招标要求逐条检查投标文件的响应位置，报告哪些要求看起来有应答、哪些匹配较弱、哪些未能定位；只报告差异，不判断是否实质满足。
